note: Read 2026-10-30. Republic Act No. 10930 (2017), amending the Land Transportation and Traffic Code, makes every driver's licence but a student permit valid for five years from the holder's birthday, ten on renewal for a driver with no violation (read on the LawPhil Project's copy; the Official Gazette's own page is behind a bot check). LTO Memorandum Circular No. 495-2004 (the Supreme Court E-Library's copy) says an applicant for a non-professional licence must be at least seventeen (eighteen for a professional one); it is a 2004 circular on converting foreign licences, the latest statement of the age read, so 17 is held. The LTO's own pages are behind a bot check and its fee wasn't read, so the fee is null. The student permit and the professional licence aren't held. The national ID (PhilID) is the ids engine's.

sources.title: Republic Act No. 10930 (2017), The LawPhil Project
sources.said: "Except for student permits, all drivers' licenses shall be valid for five (5) years reckoned from the birthdate of the licensee
